correctness.rationale: Thaddeus explicitly states Vainsencher's recursive blow-up construction. The rank-r center has the standard kernel/image factorization, with base consisting of an u-plane, an (u-r)-plane kernel, and an r-plane image, and fiber the square complete-collineation compactification C_r. Its codimension is the determinantal value (u-r)(w-r). The smooth blow-up Euler formula then gives the recurrence. In the square case the induction reduces to (j^2-1)/(j!)^2=1/((j-1)!)^2-1/(j!)^2; in the rectangular case the analogous identity is (j(q+j)-1)/(j!(q+j)!)=1/((j-1)!(q+j-1)!)-1/(j!(q+j)!). Both telescope exactly to the stated factorial formula. The bundled checker replays the recurrences over broad finite ranges.

value.rationale: Complete collineations are a classical wonderful compactification used in enumerative and birational geometry. The theorem gives a closed topological invariant uniformly for every source dimension, target dimension, and rank. The square value (u!)^2 is especially rigid, and the general formula separates exactly into the two Grassmannian choices and that square fiber value. The proof also exposes a non-obvious telescoping cancellation among all exceptional-divisor contributions, making the result structurally informative rather than a routine small-rank computation.
